overview.oneLineTake: A hawkish monetary shock layered atop a live geopolitical conflict and negative seasonal currents is forcing a rapid repricing of risk, pushing volatility higher and favoring defensive positioning.
themes: Hawkish Fed pivot under Warsh reprices rate-hike risk, sending 10-year yields above 4.75% and tightening financial conditions
U.S.-Iran military escalation drives Brent crude above $90/bbl, stoking stagflationary supply-shock fears across assets
AI boom persists but equity leadership narrows to mega-cap tech while small-caps and breadth deteriorate

risks: Strait of Hormuz / Iran war escalation threatens sustained energy price spikes and logistics disruption
